jp: \t\t神との対話を行うことで、信仰を深めることができる巻物。巻き物というより神へ宛てた手紙の様なものなのだろう。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t神との対話を行うことで、信仰を深めることができる巻物。巻き物というより神へ宛てた手紙の様なものなのだろう。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: A scroll that allows people to deepen their faith by conversing with God. It's probably more like a letter to God than a scroll. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "A scroll that allows people to deepen their faith by conversing with God. It's probably more like a letter to God than a scroll. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena che permette di approfondire la fede parlando col proprio dio. Più che una pergamena sarà una specie di lettera indirizzata a lui. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t肉体を成長させる魔法がかけられた貴重な巻物。読むことであなたは更に強靭になるだろう。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t肉体を成長させる魔法がかけられた貴重な巻物。読むことであなたは更に強靭になるだろう。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: These precious scrolls are enchanted to develop your body. Reading it will make you even stronger. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "These precious scrolls are enchanted to develop your body. Reading it will make you even stronger. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena preziosa, su cui è posata una magia che fa crescere il corpo. A leggerla diventerai più tenace. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t何かがある箇所を察知させる巻物。何があるかわからない壁の向こうや、透明の物体をも感知できるため、探索時には用意しておきたい。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t何かがある箇所を察知させる巻物。何があるかわからない壁の向こうや、透明の物体をも感知できるため、探索時には用意しておきたい。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: Scrolls that allow the user to detect the location of objects. It can detect objects behind walls, or even invisible objects, so it should be readied when searching for something. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "Scrolls that allow the user to detect the location of objects. It can detect objects behind walls, or even invisible objects, so it should be readied when searching for something. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena che fa avvertire dove c'è qualcosa. Sente anche al di là di un muro, dove non si sa cosa ci sia, e perfino gli oggetti invisibili: conviene tenerne pronta una quando si esplora. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t一時的に賢くなれる巻物。試験の季節になると碌に勉強もせず、この巻物を当てにした客で道具屋が一時的に賑わうという。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t一時的に賢くなれる巻物。試験の季節になると碌に勉強もせず、この巻物を当てにした客で道具屋が一時的に賑わうという。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: A scroll that makes you smarter temporarily. It is said that during the examination season, the tool shops are temporarily crowded with customers who rely on these scrolls without studying as far as they are concerned. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "A scroll that makes you smarter temporarily. It is said that during the examination season, the tool shops are temporarily crowded with customers who rely on these scrolls without studying as far as they are concerned. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena che rende svegli per un po'. Si dice che nella stagione degli esami le botteghe si riempiano per un momento di clienti che, invece di studiare, contano su questa. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t読むと空からマテリアルが落ちてくる奇妙な巻物。何故巻物を読むとマテリアルが降ってくるのか、この関連性は未だ以て不明である。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t読むと空からマテリアルが落ちてくる奇妙な巻物。何故巻物を読むとマテリアルが降ってくるのか、この関連性は未だ以て不明である。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: Strange scrolls that, when read, cause materials to fall from the sky. It is still unclear why materials fall from the sky when the scroll is read. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "Strange scrolls that, when read, cause materials to fall from the sky. It is still unclear why materials fall from the sky when the scroll is read. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una strana pergamena che, a leggerla, fa cadere dei materiali dal cielo. Perché a leggere una pergamena piovano materiali, questo legame non si è ancora capito. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t読むことで一瞬のうちに肉体をマナで満たす巻物。緊急時に一巻持っていると思った以上に役立つらしい。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t読むことで一瞬のうちに肉体をマナで満たす巻物。緊急時に一巻持っていると思った以上に役立つらしい。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: A scroll that, when read, instantly fills the body with mana. They say that having a scroll with you in an emergency is more useful than you think. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "A scroll that, when read, instantly fills the body with mana. They say that having a scroll with you in an emergency is more useful than you think. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena che, letta, riempie di mana il corpo in un istante. Pare che averne una addosso nei momenti critici serva più di quanto si creda. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t身にかかった呪いを全て打ち消す巻物。尚、勝手が違うのか装備品の呪いは打ち消すことはできない。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t身にかかった呪いを全て打ち消す巻物。尚、勝手が違うのか装備品の呪いは打ち消すことはできない。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: A scroll that cancels all curses on the body. It does not cancel curses on equipment. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "A scroll that cancels all curses on the body. It does not cancel curses on equipment. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena che annulla tutte le maledizioni che si hanno addosso. Quelle su un oggetto indossato no: là, chissà perché, non funziona. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t身にかかった呪いを１つ打ち消す巻物。尚、勝手が違うのか装備品の呪いは打ち消すことはできない。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t身にかかった呪いを１つ打ち消す巻物。尚、勝手が違うのか装備品の呪いは打ち消すことはできない。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: A scroll that cancels 1 curses on the body. It does not cancel curses on equipment. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "A scroll that cancels 1 curses on the body. It does not cancel curses on equipment. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena che annulla una maledizione che si ha addosso. Quelle su un oggetto indossato no: là, chissà perché, non funziona. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t身に降りかかる呪いを防ぐという聖なる衣を一時的に展開する巻物だ。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t身に降りかかる呪いを防ぐという聖なる衣を一時的に展開する巻物だ。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: It is a scroll that temporarily deploys a sacred robe that is said to protect the body from curses. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "It is a scroll that temporarily deploys a sacred robe that is said to protect the body from curses. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena che stende per un po' un velo sacro, che si dice protegga dalle maledizioni che piombano addosso. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t身につけた装備品の呪いを解く巻物。より強力である為解呪に失敗することはない、はずだ。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t身につけた装備品の呪いを解く巻物。より強力である為解呪に失敗することはない、はずだ。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: Scrolls that break the curse of worn equipment. It is more powerful and thus never fails to break the curse. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "Scrolls that break the curse of worn equipment. It is more powerful and thus never fails to break the curse. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena che toglie la maledizione a un oggetto indossato. Essendo più forte, la purificazione non fallisce mai. Dovrebbe. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t未鑑定の品を鑑定する巻物。より強力であるが、それでも鑑定できない場合は大人しく魔道士に調査してもらおう。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t未鑑定の品を鑑定する巻物。より強力であるが、それでも鑑定できない場合は大人しく魔道士に調査してもらおう。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: A scroll that appraises unappraised items. It is more powerful, but if the item still cannot be appraised, have it investigated by a mage instead. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "A scroll that appraises unappraised items. It is more powerful, but if the item still cannot be appraised, have it investigated by a mage instead. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena che identifica gli oggetti non identificati. È più forte del solito, ma se anche così l'oggetto non si lascia identificare, tanto vale farlo esaminare da un mago. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t家を購入する為の手続きとして必要な権利書。冒険者といえど、常に野宿というわけにはいかないのだ。\n#～今日から君も冒険者・旅用マニュアル～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t家を購入する為の手続きとして必要な権利書。冒険者といえど、常に野宿というわけにはいかないのだ。\n#～今日から君も冒険者・旅用マニュアル～\n"
en: A deed gives the right to a house. Even adventurers cannot always camp out in the wilderness. \n# ~an Adventurer is You! Guide for Travels~
en_grezzo: "A deed gives the right to a house. Even adventurers cannot always camp out in the wilderness. \n# ~an Adventurer is You! Guide for Travels~"
it: L'atto che serve come pratica per comprare una casa. Anche a essere avventurieri, non si può dormire sempre all'addiaccio. \n# ~Da Oggi Avventuriero Anche Tu: Manuale di Viaggio~

jp: \t\t身につけた装備品に呪いかける危険な巻物。使用した際に稀に効果を発揮しないで塵となる場合があるが、恐らくは日頃の行いの結果だろう。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t身につけた装備品に呪いかける危険な巻物。使用した際に稀に効果を発揮しないで塵となる場合があるが、恐らくは日頃の行いの結果だろう。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: Dangerous scrolls that cast a curse on worn equipment. In some rare cases when it is used, it may not work and turn to dust, probably as a result of daily conduct. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "Dangerous scrolls that cast a curse on worn equipment. In some rare cases when it is used, it may not work and turn to dust, probably as a result of daily conduct. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena pericolosa, che getta una maledizione su un oggetto indossato. Certe rare volte, quando la si usa, non fa effetto e si sbriciola: sarà il frutto della condotta di tutti i giorni. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t空間に小さな歪みを作り出すことで一瞬のうちに移動することができる巻物。効力がやや弱い為、人と別れる際に使用してすぐ傍にまた現れてしまい気まずい思いをした、という笑い話もあるようだ。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t空間に小さな歪みを作り出すことで一瞬のうちに移動することができる巻物。効力がやや弱い為、人と別れる際に使用してすぐ傍にまた現れてしまい気まずい思いをした、という笑い話もあるようだ。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: A scroll that creates a small distortion in space, allowing a person to travel instantaneously. Because its potency is rather weak, there are some funny stories about people who used it when they were leaving someone, only to have it reappear nearby, causing them to feel awkward. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "A scroll that creates a small distortion in space, allowing a person to travel instantaneously. Because its potency is rather weak, there are some funny stories about people who used it when they were leaving someone, only to have it reappear nearby, causing them to feel awkward. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena che, creando una piccola piega nello spazio, sposta in un istante. Ha un effetto piuttosto debole, e si racconta per ridere di gente che l'ha usata per accomiatarsi da qualcuno e si è ritrovata a ricomparirgli accanto, con tutto l'imbarazzo del caso. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t頭に突然魔法の知識が浮かぶ巻物。一説では、神々が自らの魔法を忘れないようにしたためた本から落ちた、ページの切れはしだと考えられている。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t頭に突然魔法の知識が浮かぶ巻物。一説では、神々が自らの魔法を忘れないようにしたためた本から落ちた、ページの切れはしだと考えられている。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: Scrolls of magical knowledge. One theory is that they are fragments of pages that fell out of a book in which the gods had written down their magic so that they would not forget it. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "Scrolls of magical knowledge. One theory is that they are fragments of pages that fell out of a book in which the gods had written down their magic so that they would not forget it. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena che fa affiorare di colpo nella testa una conoscenza magica. Secondo una teoria sono pezzi di pagina caduti dal libro in cui gli dei avevano messo per iscritto la propria magia, per non dimenticarla. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t読むことで新たな能力を得るとされる貴重な巻物。遠く、異国の地ではこれらの巻物のことをヒデンショと読んでいたという。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t読むことで新たな能力を得るとされる貴重な巻物。遠く、異国の地ではこれらの巻物のことをヒデンショと読んでいたという。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: Precious scrolls that are said to give new abilities when read. In distant, far away foreign lands, these scrolls were called Master Recipe Tomes. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "Precious scrolls that are said to give new abilities when read. In distant, far away foreign lands, these scrolls were called Master Recipe Tomes. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena preziosa, che a leggerla darebbe una capacità nuova. Si dice che in terre lontane e straniere queste pergamene le chiamassero hidensho. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t周辺の地形を瞬時に読み取る巻物。主にネフィア用の巻物なので、気になるあの娘の家に侵入して使うという不届きな使い方はできない。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t周辺の地形を瞬時に読み取る巻物。主にネフィア用の巻物なので、気になるあの娘の家に侵入して使うという不届きな使い方はできない。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: A scroll that instantly reads the surrounding terrain. This scroll is mainly for Nefia, so you can't use it to break into the house of that girl you're interested in. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "A scroll that instantly reads the surrounding terrain. This scroll is mainly for Nefia, so you can't use it to break into the house of that girl you're interested in. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena che legge in un istante il terreno intorno. Serve soprattutto dentro Nefia, quindi la trovata poco pulita di intrufolarsi in casa della ragazza che ti piace per usarla lì non funziona. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t特定の場所と繋がる門を呼びだす巻物。誤って使用した場合でも慌てず騒がず、再度読むと取り消すことができる。当然ながら２枚消費するが、勉強代と思って諦めよう。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t特定の場所と繋がる門を呼びだす巻物。誤って使用した場合でも慌てず騒がず、再度読むと取り消すことができる。当然ながら２枚消費するが、勉強代と思って諦めよう。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: A scroll that invokes a gate leading to the specified location. If used by mistake, it can be undone by reading it again. Naturally, two copies are consumed, but consider it a tuition fee. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "A scroll that invokes a gate leading to the specified location. If used by mistake, it can be undone by reading it again. Naturally, two copies are consumed, but consider it a tuition fee. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena che chiama un portale collegato a un luogo preciso. Anche se la si usa per sbaglio, niente panico: rileggendola si annulla. Ovviamente se ne consumano due, ma pazienza: consideralo il prezzo della lezione. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t身につけた装備品の呪いを解く巻物。呪いが強力すぎる場合解呪に失敗するが、そうなった時は何か別の手を考えよう。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t身につけた装備品の呪いを解く巻物。呪いが強力すぎる場合解呪に失敗するが、そうなった時は何か別の手を考えよう。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: Scrolls that break the curse of worn equipment. It sometimes fails on strong curses. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "Scrolls that break the curse of worn equipment. It sometimes fails on strong curses. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena che toglie la maledizione a un oggetto indossato. Se la maledizione è troppo forte la purificazione fallisce, e allora conviene pensare a un'altra strada. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t一瞬で別人になりすますことができる巻物。使った時の気分はさながら国を動かす大怪盗だ。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t一瞬で別人になりすますことができる巻物。使った時の気分はさながら国を動かす大怪盗だ。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: A scroll that allows you to impersonate someone else in an instant. When you use it, you feel like a great thief who steals the country. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "A scroll that allows you to impersonate someone else in an instant. When you use it, you feel like a great thief who steals the country. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena che in un istante permette di farsi passare per un altro. Usandola ci si sente il grande ladro che tiene in scacco un regno. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t空間に歪みを作り出すことで一瞬のうちに別の場所に移動することができる巻物。緊急時には便利だが行き先までは指定できないので待ち合わせに遅れた時等には使えないだろう。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t空間に歪みを作り出すことで一瞬のうちに別の場所に移動することができる巻物。緊急時には便利だが行き先までは指定できないので待ち合わせに遅れた時等には使えないだろう。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: A scroll that creates a distortion in space, allowing you to travel elsewhere instantaneously. It is useful in emergencies, but the destination cannot be specified, so it cannot be used if you are late for a meeting, for example. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "A scroll that creates a distortion in space, allowing you to travel elsewhere instantaneously. It is useful in emergencies, but the destination cannot be specified, so it cannot be used if you are late for a meeting, for example. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena che, creando una piega nello spazio, porta in un istante da un'altra parte. Nei momenti critici è comoda, ma la meta non si può scegliere: per quando si è in ritardo a un appuntamento, non serve. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t伝説の品の存在を知ることができるとされる巻物。誰が持っているかまでは教えてくれない、神はそこまであなたに親身ではないのだ。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t伝説の品の存在を知ることができるとされる巻物。誰が持っているかまでは教えてくれない、神はそこまであなたに親身ではないのだ。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: The scrolls are supposed to tell you about the existence of legendary items. It doesn't even tell you who has it, God is not that friendly to you. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "The scrolls are supposed to tell you about the existence of legendary items. It doesn't even tell you who has it, God is not that friendly to you. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena che, si dice, faccia sapere dell'esistenza degli oggetti leggendari. Chi ce li abbia non lo dice: il dio non ti è amico fino a quel punto. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t未鑑定の品を鑑定する巻物。強力な品の場合鑑定できない場合があるが、そういった場合は魔道士の手を借りよう。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t未鑑定の品を鑑定する巻物。強力な品の場合鑑定できない場合があるが、そういった場合は魔道士の手を借りよう。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: A scroll that appraises unappraised items. It is useless agains powerful items, you will need a mage instead. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~
en_grezzo: "A scroll that appraises unappraised items. It is useless agains powerful items, you will need a mage instead. \n#~Arcane Alamanac~"
it: Una pergamena che identifica gli oggetti non identificati. Con gli oggetti potenti certe volte non ce la fa, e in quei casi conviene farsi dare una mano da un mago. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~
